content.text:
The `tiles` deployment in `geo-17b7` now matches `tiles.yaml`, with the selector `app=tiles, scheme=v2`. It shows 2/2 ready, and the `tiles` service endpoints list both new pods.

The selector field can't be changed on an existing deployment, so I had to delete and recreate it. To keep tiles available, I did it in this order:
1. I created a temporary deployment, `tiles-tmp`, with the same pod spec plus an extra `slot: tmp` label. The `tiles` service selects `app=tiles`, so it sent traffic to the temporary pods. I waited until both were ready.
2. I deleted the old `tiles` deployment and applied `tiles.yaml`, then waited for the rollout to finish.
3. I deleted `tiles-tmp`. Its two pods were still terminating when I last checked.

I didn't probe the service during the swap, so I haven't confirmed there were no failed requests.
